refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often the contest lists are fetched.

hide_longer_than_days.label: Hide events longer than (days)
hide_longer_than_days.description: Hides multi-day events such as long practice rounds or online challenges. Contests you have hearted are always shown. 0 shows everything.

reminders_enabled.label: Contest reminders
reminders_enabled.description: Send a notification for contests you have marked with the heart.

remind_minutes.label: Remind me before start (minutes)
remind_minutes.description: How long before the start the reminder is sent. 0 turns off the early reminder.

remind_at_start.label: Remind me when it starts
remind_at_start.description: Send a second notification at the start time.

past_days.label: Recent contests window (days)
past_days.description: How long finished contests stay in the Previous list. Contests you saved for upsolving stay until you unsave them.

visible_items.label: Desktop widget contests
visible_items.description: How many upcoming contests the desktop widget lists.

panel.title: Contests
panel.empty_saved: Nothing saved yet - bookmark a finished contest to upsolve it later.
panel.empty_previous: No recent contests match these filters.

filters.favorites_tooltip: Only contests I'm taking part in

rows.saved_on: Saved for upsolving - click to remove
